resume: DUELL turns the FM-1 into a bitimbral synth: two complete parts, three ways to play them together (DUEL, STEREO, LAYER) and a MORPH that glides between two versions of each sound.

commandes.role: Octave down on release; held with a rotary knob, resets its card to default.
Octave up on release; in a dialog, confirms.
The part's effect pages. Held, opens PERFORM: the 16 white keys are held effects.
Opens MIXER (levels and pans of the two parts). Held, the knobs set these levels from any page.
Opens the MORPH page. Held, opens the menu.
Opens PATCHES, PATTERNS or MULTIS depending on where you are. Held, offers to overwrite the slot.
Arms recording on the sequencer pages; elsewhere, switches HOLD on or off.
Changes subpage; in a list, moves.
Loads sounds for the selected part.
Chooses part 1 or 2; on MORPH, PART 1, BOTH or PART 2.

gestes: GLO held: levels and pans of the two parts.

modes.texte: Dual mono: part 1 on the left, part 2 on the right, isolated, effects included.
Both parts in a single stereo field, for headphones.
Default mode: both parts on the keys together, with balance, velocity crossfade and keyboard split.
